blocks.en: Abstract

We present DOPER, an RGB pose estimation framework that shares a visual backbone across object detection, segmentation, and keypoint prediction to recover the 6D pose of known objects through Perspective-n-Point. Starting from synthetic training, DOPER adapts to real observations using partial supervision while retaining synthetic keypoint labels. Calibrated multi-view observations provide geometric constraints for keypoint supervision. During inference, optional heatmap refinement fits a rigid pose directly to the predicted keypoint distributions, resolving ambiguous correspondences without depth input or a learned pose refiner. Starting from underspecified CAD models, DOPER progressively refines the object representation and pose estimator. Results on SPEED+ and SHIRT further demonstrate effective adaptation to illumination changes and accurate temporal pose estimation. Across the evaluated single-view and multi-view configurations, DOPER achieves state-of-the-art detection AP results on HANDAL, HOPEv2, HOT3D, and T-LESS while using only RGB and running in real time (35 Hz per object model on one GB300). These results demonstrate the effectiveness of jointly learning detection and pose keypoints, with real observations and geometric constraints.
blocks.zh: 我们提出DOPER,一个 RGB 提出的估算框架,它共享一个视觉主干线,跨越物体检测,分化,以及关键点预测,通过Perspect-n-Point恢复已知物体的6D姿势. 从合成训练开始,DOPER在保留合成键点标签的同时,通过部分监督来适应真实的观测. 校正多视图观测为关键点监督提供了几何限制. 在推论中,可选取的热映射精炼直接与所预测的键点分布相接而成的刚性姿势相接而成,在没有深度输入或所学取的姿势精炼器的情况下解决模棱两可的函式. DOPER从规格不高的CAD模型开始,逐渐地精炼出对象的表示并形成估计. 关于SPEED+和SHIRT的结果进一步表明,它们有效地适应了光线的变化,准确的时间估计。 在整个被评价的单景和多景配置中,DOPER在HANDAL,HOPEv2,HOT3D,和T-LESS上实现了最先进的检测AP结果,同时只使用RGB并实时运行(一GB300上每个对象模型35Hz). 这些结果显示了共同学习探测的效果,并提出了关键点,有真实的观测和几何限制.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction

Object pose estimation is fundamental to robotic manipulation.
Given a 3D model, the goal is to first discover the object in the image then recover 3D position and orientation relative to a reference coordinate frame.
Accurate estimates enable tasks such as grasping a small cable connector and inserting it into a tight-fitting receptacle.
Existing approaches range from classical geometric methods, such as Perspective- n n -Point (P n n P), to learning-based render-and-compare methods.
In practice, however, the available 3D model often differs from the physical object: textures may be inaccurate, geometry may be incomplete, and external components such as tags may be absent. These discrepancies challenge pose estimation in real-world settings.
blocks.zh:
物体姿势估计是机器人操纵的根本.
鉴于3D模型,目标是首先在图像中发现对象,然后恢复相对于参考坐标框架的3D位置和方向.
准确的估计可以完成诸如抓住一个小电缆连接器并将其插入一个紧凑的贮器等任务。
现有方法从经典的几何方法,例如Perspect-n-Point(P nn P),到基于学习的渲染和比较方法。
然而实际上,现有的3D模型往往与物理对象不同:纹理可能不准确,几何可能不完整,标记等外部组件可能缺失. 这些差异性挑战构成了现实环境中的估计数。

blocks.en:
Bridging this model-to-reality gap requires robustness to both appearance variation and geometric discrepancies.
One way to bridge this gap is to expose a pose estimator to sufficient variation during training, so that it learns to tolerate differences between synthetic images and real observations [ 59 , 60 ] .
Scaling this strategy to diverse object collections has enabled pose estimation for previously unseen objects, substantially reducing the need for object-specific training [ 31 , 71 ] . Unfortunately, generalization to new objects does not by itself resolve errors in the supplied model: rendering that model under more viewpoints or lighting conditions cannot recover a missing component.
Real observations therefore provide information that synthetic training alone may lack.
Even a few reference images can support pose estimation for a new object [ 22 , 15 ] , while test-time adaptation allows an estimator to learn from its deployment environment without requiring annotated target data [ 25 , 52 , 33 ] .
blocks.zh:
弥合这种模型与真实性的差距,需要坚固的外观变化和几何差异。
弥补这一差距的一种方法是让姿势估计者在训练期间受到足够的差异,从而学会容忍合成图像与真实观察之间的差异[59,60].
将这一策略推广到各种对象集合中,使得能够对以前未见的物体作出估计,从而大大减少了对特定对象的培训的需要[31、71]。 不幸的是,对新物体的概括本身并不能解决所提供模型的错误:在更多视角或照明条件下使该模型无法恢复缺失的组件.
因此,真正的观察提供了仅靠合成培训可能缺乏的信息。
即使是少数参考图像也可以支持对新对象进行估计[22,15],而测试时间的调整则允许估计者从其部署环境中学习,而不需要附加说明的目标数据[25,52,33].

blocks.en:
Despite recent advances, the precision required for robotic manipulation remains challenging.
We introduce Deep Object Pose Estimation Revisited (DOPER), a pose estimation framework that uses real-world observations to progressively improve accuracy.
Starting from an incomplete 3D model, DOPER is initially trained on synthetic images generated using domain randomization [ 60 ] .
It jointly predicts object bounding boxes, segmentation masks, quantized orientations, and keypoint heatmaps, with the latter used to recover the final pose through P n n P.
The initial estimator lacks the desired precision because it uses an underspecified 3D model. However, it provides a useful starting point for adaptation (Figure 1 ).
We introduce two complementary test-time adaptation mechanisms that build on these predictions, enabling DOPER to achieve competitive results.
blocks.zh:
尽管最近取得了进展,但机器人操纵所需的精确度仍然具有挑战性。
我们引入了深对象估计重估(DOPER),这个姿势估计框架利用现实世界的观测来逐步提高准确度.
从一个不完整的3D模型开始,DOPER最初接受了使用域随机化生成的合成图像的培训[60].
它共同预测物体的边框,分块口罩,定量方向,以及关键点热映射,后者用来通过Pn n P来恢复最终的姿势.
初始估计器缺乏所期望的精确度,因为它使用的是规格不足的3D模型. 然而,它为适应提供了一个有用的起点(图1)。
我们采用了两个相辅相成的试验时间适应机制,这些机制以这些预测为基础,使DOPER能够取得竞争性结果。

blocks.en:
We use monocular or multi-view adaptation to generate supervision from the deployment environment.
For monocular observations, we keep only labels that do not require a precise metric pose: bounding boxes, segmentation masks, and quantized orientations.
With multi-view observations, obtained from stereo cameras or a moving camera,
geometric constraints additionally support reliable keypoint supervision through triangulation.
We then fine-tune the estimator using the resulting supervision.
The updated model can generate further pseudo-labels or be deployed. This iterative process is key for real-world deployment.
We make the following contributions:
blocks.zh:
我们使用单视或多视度的适应,从部署环境中产生监督。
对于单体观测,我们只保留不需要精确的度量姿势的标签:边框,片段口罩,以及量化方向.
通过从立体摄像机或移动摄像机获得的多视图观测,
几何限制还有助于通过三角测量进行可靠的关键点监督。
然后,我们利用由此产生的监督,对估计器进行微调。
更新的模型可以产生更多的伪标签或被部署. 这个迭代过程是现实世界部署的关键.
我们作出以下贡献:

blocks.en: • We introduce DOPER, an object-specific framework that jointly predicts detections and pose keypoints supporting real-time 6D pose estimation. • We propose an adaptation protocol from noisy pseudo-labels (single-view) to geometric supervision (multi-view) observations to refine underspecified 3D models, and improve pose detection and estimation. • We demonstrate state-of-the-art results across HANDAL [ 17 ] , HOT3D [ 1 ] , HOPEv2 [ 61 , 41 ] , T-LESS [ 23 ] , and the satellite pose benchmarks SPEED+ [ 46 ] and SHIRT [ 44 ] .
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们引入了DOPER,这是一个针对特定对象的框架,它共同预测检测结果,并提出支持实时6D的临界点。 我们提出一个从吵闹的伪标签(单一视图)到几何监督(多视图)观测的适应协议,以完善规格不足的立体模型,并改进定位检测和估计。 我们展示了整个HANDAL [17]、HOT3D [1]、HOPEv2 [61,41]、T-LESS [23] 的最新成果,卫星提出了SPEED+[46]和SHIRT [44]的基准。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work

Object pose estimation. Learning-based object pose estimators can be organized by how they recover pose: geometric estimation from correspondences, direct pose regression, and render-and-compare alignment. Correspondence-based methods predict keypoints or dense matches and recover pose using P n n P for 2D–3D correspondences, or point-set alignment for 3D–3D correspondences [ 60 , 49 , 50 , 58 , 20 , 21 , 24 , 55 ] .
HccePose(BF) [ 69 ] predicts front and back surface coordinates from detected object crops and samples points between them to construct ultra-dense correspondences for P n n P, while DOPER jointly predicts detections and sparse keypoints.
Recent methods extend correspondence learning to unseen objects using reference observations [ 56 , 19 ] : COG [ 5 ] estimates confidence-aware soft correspondences between a reference and query RGB-D image, PANY [ 74 ] combines multi-view geometry and cross-view matching, recovering pose through P n n P or point-set alignment depending on depth availability. Direct regression methods learn the mapping to pose parameters [ 65 , 73 , 63 , 8 , 27 , 18 ] . Render-and-compare methods align rendered object views with observations to score and refine pose hypotheses [ 31 , 71 , 34 , 30 , 26 , 68 ] .
DOPER follows the keypoint-and-P n n P approach and specializes it to the deployment environment through iterative learning from real observations and refinement of an initially incomplete object representation.
blocks.zh:
对象提出估计。 基于学习的物体的构型可以根据其恢复的姿势来组织:从函证中几何估计,直接的姿势回归,以及渲染和比较的对齐. 基于函证的方法预测了键位或稠密的匹配,并使用Pn n P对2D–3D的函证,或对3D–3D的函证[60,49,50,58,20,21,24,55]的点位设置对齐.
HccePose(BF)[69]预测从检测到的物体作物和它们之间的样本点中产生的前表面和后表面坐标,以构建Pn n P的超强度对应,而DOPER则联合预测检测和稀疏的键点.
近代方法利用参考观测[56,19]:COG[5]估计参考和查询RGB-D图像之间的信任感软通信,PANY[74]结合了多视图几何和交叉视图匹配,通过Pn n P或点设置对齐来恢复姿势,视深度可用性而定. 直接回归方法学习绘图以形成参数[65,73,63,8,27,18]. Render-and-compare方法使给定的对象视图与观测结果一致,以便得分和完善假说[31、71、34、30、26、68]。
DOPER遵循键点和-P n n P方法,并通过从实际观测中反复学习和完善最初不完整的物体表示,将其专门用于部署环境.

blocks.en:
Self-supervised learning and test-time adaptation. Real observations can improve synthetically trained pose estimators without requiring manual pose annotations [ 66 , 33 , 25 , 64 , 54 , 32 , 75 , 14 , 72 ] .
Adaptation has also been coupled with object reconstruction [ 52 , 57 , 6 , 35 , 67 , 13 ] .
DOPER builds on these directions through complementary monocular and multi-view supervision, and uses an object reconstruction from onboarding videos to correct an underspecified CAD model when rendering training data.
Signals from pretrained models support repeated training on real observations and randomized CAD renders, targeting the precision required for robotic manipulation.
blocks.zh:
自主督导学习和试时适应. 真正的观测可以改进人工训练的模拟器,而不需要人工说明[66、33、25、64、54、32、75、14、72]。
适应还伴随着物体重建[52、57、6、35、67、13]。
DOPER通过互补的单视和多视监督来在这些方向的基础上发展,并在提供训练数据时使用从登机视频中进行对象重建来修正一个规格不足的CAD模型.
来自预训模型的信号支持进行关于真实观测和随机化CAD的反复训练,针对机器人操纵所需的精度.

Mixed real and synthetic supervision updates the estimator,

图2:单体观测提供了框、面具和粗略定向目标(上行)。
多视图观测还提供了关键点目标,并改进了新培训对象的外观(下行)。

blocks.en:
Overview and problem formulation. DOPER combines synthetic supervision and real observations to adapt an object-specific pose estimator (Figure 2 ).
Given a calibrated RGB image, an approximate CAD model, and ordered object-frame keypoints, we estimate object rotation and translation relative to the camera.
The CAD appearance and surface details may be incomplete, but metric scale must be known.
Keypoint identities and their coordinate frame remain fixed throughout adaptation.
blocks.zh:
概述和问题表述。 DOPER将合成监督与真实观测结合起来,以适应特定物体的外观估计器(图2 )。
考虑到一个校准的RGB图像,一个大致的CAD模型,以及命令对象框键点,我们估计对象旋转和相对于相机的翻译.
CAD的外观和表面细节可能不完整,但必须知道衡量尺度。
关键点身份及其坐标框架在整个适应过程中保持不变。

blocks.en:
Shared visual representation and geometric pose estimation. Following the correspondence-based formulation of DOPE [ 60 ] , we predict image locations of known object points and recover pose with P n n P.
Our implementation shares a DINOv3-pretrained ConvNeXt backbone [ 53 ] between a full-image branch and an object-crop branch.
The full-image branch combines multi-scale features at stride four and predicts object centers, bounding-box dimensions, center offsets, and a foreground mask.
Detection follows the CenterNet formulation [ 76 ] .
For each detected box, the crop branch resamples the original image at higher resolution and applies the same backbone weights, followed by a keypoint head.
This preserves small-object detail while sharing detection and segmentation supervision with keypoint localization.
The head predicts a spatial distribution per keypoint; decoded coordinates are mapped to the original image by the inverse crop transform.
Confidence filtering and robust P n n P select consistent 2D–3D correspondences and minimize squared reprojection error, accounting for camera calibration and lens distortion.
blocks.zh:
共同的视觉表现和几何估计。 根据DOPE[60]的对应配方,我们预测已知物体点的图像位置,并用Pn n P恢复姿势.
我们的执行在全图像分支和对象作物分支之间共享一个DINOv3预选的ConvNEXt主干线[53].
全图像分支结合了步态4的多尺度特性,并预测对象中心,边框尺寸,中心偏移,以及前置面具.
检测遵循CenterNet的配制[76].
对于每个检测到的框,作物分支以更高的分辨率重印原始图像,并应用相同的骨干权重,然后是键头.
这保留了小对象细节,同时与关键点本地化共享检测和分区监管.
头部预测每个键点的空间分布;解码坐标通过逆切变来映射到原始图像.
信心过滤和坚固的Pnn P选择一致的2D–3D对应,并尽量减少平方重投射错误,计及相机校准和镜头扭曲.

blocks.en:
Synthetic initialization and partial supervision. We render the initial CAD model under variations in viewpoint, distance, lighting, material appearance, backgrounds, and distractors, following domain randomization [ 59 , 60 ] .
Each synthetic sample provides a bounding box, a visible-object mask, and projected keypoints in the fixed object frame.
Photometric augmentation models additional appearance variation, while crop translation, scale, and rotation augmentation expose the keypoint branch to imperfect detections.
All geometric augmentations are applied consistently to the keypoint targets.
We optimize a weighted sum of detection, mask, and keypoint objectives jointly.
The detection term combines a center-heatmap focal loss with absolute-error losses for box dimensions and offsets; the mask term combines binary cross-entropy and soft Dice losses [ 36 ] .
For keypoints, we use cross-entropy between normalized Gaussian target heatmaps and spatially normalized predictions, equivalent to minimizing their KL divergence up to a target-dependent constant.
Losses are normalized over available supervision, with validity-weighted keypoint terms and zero contribution from missing annotations.
This allows fully labeled synthetic and partially labeled real images to train one model.
blocks.zh:
合成初始化和部分监督. 我们使最初的CAD模型在视线、距离、照明、物质外观、背景和分心器等变化下,遵循域随机化[59、60]。
每个合成样品都提供了一个边框,一个可见对象面具,以及固定对象框中的投射键点.
光度增强模型增加了外观变异,而作物翻译,尺度,和旋转增强则使关键点分支暴露在不完美的检测中.
所有几何增强均一致地适用于关键点目标。
我们优化了检测、面具和关键点目标的加权总和。
检测术语结合了中热图焦值损失和盒尺寸和抵消的绝对-error损失;掩码术语结合了二进制交叉和软滴滴损失[36].
对于关键点,我们使用正态高斯目标热映射和空间正态预测之间的交叉切入,相当于将其KL差降到一个目标依赖常数.
与现有监督相比,损失是正常的,其有效性加权关键词和缺失说明的零贡献。
这允许完全贴上标签的合成和部分贴上标签的真实图像来训练一种模型.

blocks.en:
Monocular adaptation. We retain high-confidence detections from unlabeled real images and use their bounding boxes to prompt a general-purpose segmentation model [ 51 ] .
Alternatively, a reliable pose supplies a projected CAD mask when the model adequately represents the object and external occlusions are absent.
blocks.zh:
单曲改编. 我们保留了对无标签真实图像的高信任度检测,并使用它们的捆绑箱来推动通用分解模型[51].
或者,当模型充分代表物体时,可靠的姿势可以提供预测的CAD面具,而外部的遮盖则不存在。

blocks.en:
Optionally, a rotation quantization head provides additional supervision from
monocular observations by predicting a distribution over reference
orientations, with soft targets reflecting their angular proximity.
Agreement between this distribution and the P n n P estimate helps select
reliable pseudo-orientations for adapting the shared representation.
blocks.zh:
可选的是,一个旋转量子化头提供额外的监督来自
通过预测参考物的分布,进行单体观测
方向,软目标反映其角近.
此分布与 Pnn P 估计数之间的协议有助于选择
采用可靠的假方向来调整共同代表制。

blocks.en:
Monocular targets comprise boxes, masks, and accepted coarse orientations.
Although the teacher uses keypoints and P n n P to assess predictions, we exclude its projected keypoints from real training labels: low reprojection error can conceal an incorrect symmetric pose or localization bias.
Auxiliary targets adapt the shared representation to real appearance, while synthetic samples retain keypoint supervision.
blocks.zh:
单体目标包括盒子、口罩和接受粗糙的方向。
虽然老师使用键位和Pnn P来评估预测,但我们却将其预测的键位从真正的训练标签中排除:低重估误差可以掩盖不正确的对称姿势或本地化偏差.
辅助目标使共享代表物适应真实的外观,而合成样品则保留了关键点监督.

blocks.en:
Multi-view supervision. We jointly fit one object pose to confident teacher keypoints in paired images with known intrinsics and fixed relative camera poses, using a robust reprojection objective.
Fits must satisfy per-view reprojection-error and correspondence-count thresholds.
Reprojecting accepted model keypoints into each camera gives geometrically consistent targets instead of copying independent teacher predictions.
For mesh-based exports, CAD projection also supplies silhouette masks and enclosing boxes, supervising detection, segmentation, and keypoint prediction.
blocks.zh:
多景监督. 我们共同搭配一个物体, 将老师的键点放在有已知内在和固定的相对相机的组合图像中, 使用强力的再预测目标。
适切性必须满足每个视图的重投影错误和函证计算阈值。
将接受的模型键点重新投射到每台相机中,会给出几何上一致的目标,而不是复制独立的教师预测.
对于以网格为基础的出口,CAD投影还提供硅胶口罩和包装盒,监督检测、分解和关键点预测。

blocks.en:
Iterative adaptation and deployment. Each round fine-tunes the current estimator with a fresh optimizer and a fixed mixture of synthetic, monocular, and multi-view data.
Every batch retains exact synthetic keypoint labels; other sources contribute only their available targets.
The backbone uses a learning rate one tenth that of the prediction heads in the reference training recipe.
The updated model can then label additional captures for a subsequent round or be deployed using the same detection–crop–keypoint–P n n P pipeline.
Unlike source-free online adaptation [ 33 ] , this procedure retains synthetic rehearsal and includes review of generated labels.
blocks.zh:
迭代适应与部署. 每轮都用新鲜的优化器和合成,单视,多视数据固定的混合物,对电流估计器进行微调.
每批都保留精确的合成键点标签;其他来源只贡献其可用目标.
骨干在参考培训食谱中使用的学习率是预测头的十分之一。
更新后的模型可以给后续回合附加捕获标记,或者使用相同的检测–crop–keypoint–P n n P 管道部署.
与无源在线改编[33]不同,这一程序保留了合成排练,并包括对生成的标签的审查.

blocks.en:
Heatmap keypoint selection. Symmetries and uncertain image evidence can produce multiple peaks in a keypoint heatmap, making independent selection of image locations ambiguous, see Figure 3 .
Using heatmap optimization, we can project the CAD keypoints into their corresponding heatmaps and bilinearly sample the spatial log probabilities.
Bounded non-linear optimization adjusts the object’s rotation and translation to minimize the summed negative log probabilities, moving all keypoints together through one rigid pose.
For multiple views, we sum the same objective over associated observations while keeping the cameras fixed.
We accept an update only if it improves the objective and keeps the keypoints in front of every participating camera.
blocks.zh:
热映射键点选择 。 共鸣和不确定的图像证据可以在一个键点热映射中产生多个峰值,使得图像位置的独立选择模棱两可,见图3 .
通过热映射优化,我们可以将CAD键位投射到相应的热映射中,并双线性地对空间日志概率进行采样.
边框非线性优化可以调整对象的旋转和翻译,以最小化总和的负对数概率,通过一个僵硬的姿势将所有键点一起移动.
对于多种观点,我们在保持摄像机固定的同时,将同一目标与相关观测相提并论。
我们只接受更新,只要它能改进目标,并将关键点保留在每个参与镜头前.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments

We evaluate DOPER on challenging model-based object detection and pose estimation tasks. We first consider BOP datasets [ 41 ] with data available for adaptation, followed by SPEED+ [ 46 ] to assess pose estimation from underspecified 3D models. We also evaluate temporal pose estimation on SHIRT, study how keypoint count with placement affect accuracy, and how model performance can be recovered with adaptation.
blocks.zh: 我们对基于模型的物体检测具有挑战性的DOPER进行评估,并提出估算任务. 我们首先考虑具备适应数据的BOP数据集[41],然后是SPEED+[46],以评估未指定三维模型的估算。 我们还评估对SHIRT作出时间估计,研究关键点的计数如何影响准确性,以及如何通过调整恢复模型性能。

blocks.en:
Metrics. We evaluate pose accuracy using BOP’s symmetry-aware MSSD and MSPD errors [ 41 ] .
Intuitively, MSSD measures how far the estimated object is displaced in 3D, whereas MSPD measures how far its projection is displaced in the image. Both use the largest pointwise discrepancy after accounting for object symmetries.
MSPD is normalized to a 640-pixel image width. For all four datasets, including T-LESS, we report official BOP test detection AP, computed as the mean of the MSSD and MSPD AP scores.
We report mean runtime per image across all object models, including detection, pose estimation, and any reported refinement, weighted by the number of evaluated images.
blocks.zh:
度量衡. 我们利用BOP的对称感知MSSD和MSPD误差来评价表态准确性[41].
MSSD直观地测量估计对象在3D中移位的距离,而MSPD测量其投影在图像中移位的距离. 两者在计算对象对称性后均使用最大点差.
MPD已正常化为640像素图像宽度. 对于包括T-LESS在内的所有四个数据集,我们报告官方BOP测试检测AP,计算为MSSD和MSPDAP的得分平均值.
我们报告指所有物体模型的每个图像的运行时间,包括探测、估计和任何报告的改进,按评估图像的数量加权。

blocks.en:
Implementation. For the controlled onboarding experiments, we train one DINOv3 ConvNeXt-Small model per object for 25 epochs on BOP physically based renders, using 640-by-640 detection images, 512-by-512 crops, and 64 fixed keypoints (see Sec. 4.4 ).
Each adaptation experiment starts from the same synthetic model and runs for three epochs with a fresh optimizer,
mixing twelve synthetic and four real images per batch, except for T-LESS, which uses ten synthetic and six real images: two from each of its three image sensors (PrimeSense, Kinect, and Canon).
We use the final checkpoint without selecting epochs on real validation scores; for the pseudo-label experiments, labels are generated once (see Appendix A ).
The pseudo-label experiments use real boxes and masks only; synthetic images retain keypoint supervision. Box/mask supervision and box/mask/keypoint supervision use ground-truth boxes, masks and/or keypoints projected from their annotated poses.
Supervised adaptation uses static onboarding annotations for HOPEv2, HANDAL and HOT3D, and annotated training images from the three T-LESS sensors.
We also train, as a strong baseline, the released ResNet34 HccePose [ 69 ] implementation on the same PBR images as DOPER under synthetic-only supervision. We allocate 50k training steps, twice the number used for DOPER.
We omit HccePose runtimes because its inference implementation was not optimized.
We evaluate HccePose using detections from CNOS and DOPER, applying box jitter to DOPER detections as a runtime augmentation to select the best bounding box.
blocks.zh:
执行。 为了进行有控制的登机实验,我们利用640乘640探测图像、512乘512作物和64个固定键点(见Sec.4.4),在BOP物理上为25个世纪每个物体培训一个DINOv3 ConvNEXt-Small模型。
每个适应实验都从同一个合成模型开始 并运行三个世纪 并有一个新鲜的优化器,
每批混合12个合成图像和4个真实图像,但T-LESS除外,它使用10个合成图像和6个真实图像:其3个图像传感器(PrimeSense,Kinect,和Canon)各2个.
我们使用最后的检查点,而不选择真实验证分数的时代;对于伪标签实验,标签生成一次(见附录A.).
伪标签实验只使用真盒和面具;合成图像保留键点监督. 箱/任务监督以及箱/任务/关键点监督使用地面真实的箱、口罩和(或)从附加说明的姿势中投射的键。
监督适应使用HOPEv2,HANDAL和HOT3D的静态登机说明,以及三个T-LESS传感器的附加说明的训练图像.
我们还在仅由合成人监督的PBR图像上,将发布的ResNet34 HccePose[69] 执行程序作为强有力的基线。 我们分配了5万个训练步骤,是DOPER使用的两倍.
我们省略了HccePose运行时间,因为其推论执行没有优化.
我们利用来自CNOS和DOPER的检测值来评价HccePose,将盒式抖音应用到DOPER检测值上,作为运行时的增强值来选择最好的边框.

Results. Table 1 reports test results for 40 HANDAL objects on 1,684 images, 28 HOPEv2 objects on 457 images, 33 HOT3D objects on 5,140 images, and 30 T-LESS objects on 1,000 images.
In single-view evaluation, every object model scans every image, retaining up to five detections above confidence 0.15 before P n n P; no GT boxes or object-presence information are used.
Adaptation improves performance across datasets, with at most an improvement of AP of 7.5 percentage points.

适应提高了各数据集的性能,AP的改进最多达7.5个百分点.

blocks.en:
Depth. With only RGB images and no separate pose refiner, DOPER still leads on two of the four benchmarks.
With optional depth correction, it achieves the best results across all four, see Table 2 .
For example, depth-based translation correction improves AP by up to 12.9 percentage points, from 62.9 to 75.8 on HOPEv2.
blocks.zh:
深处. DOPER仅拥有RGB图像,没有单独的姿势精炼器,仍然领先于四个基准中的两个.
通过可选深度校正,它取得了所有四个方面的最佳结果,见表2。
例如,基于深度的翻译校正使AP改进了12.9个百分点,从HOPEv2上的62.9升至75.8.

blocks.en:
Multi-view inference. For the reference images with camera calibration, we select the three nearest support cameras by camera-center distance and annotations of the support views are never used.
We associate detections of the same object across views using projected keypoints and a robust pairwise fit, accepting matches with a maximum per-view median reprojection error of 6 pixels.
Starting from the reference P n n P estimate, we refine a single object pose using keypoints from multiple views while keeping the cameras fixed. Keypoint confidence and RANSAC filter unreliable observations, and a Huber loss reduces the influence of remaining outliers.
blocks.zh:
多观推论. 对于带有相机校准的参考图像,我们通过相机中心距离来选择最近的三台支持相机,并且从未使用支持视图的注释.
我们利用预测的键点和强的对映合器,将同一物体的探测连接到各个视图,接受最大每个视图中位重投误差6像素的匹配。
从参考 Pn n P 估计开始,我们利用多个视图的键点来精炼单个对象的姿势,同时保持相机的固定. 关键点置信度和RANSAC过滤不可靠的观测结果,一个Huber损失会降低剩余外部效应的影响.

All 120 models use ConvNeXt-Tiny, the same frozen PBR training populations, and 25 epochs with seed 42.

blocks.en:
Placement strategies. The strategies balance coverage of the object’s shape
(see Figure 7 ),
distinctive geometric features, and visibility.
Farthest-point sampling (FPS) spreads points by repeatedly selecting the point farthest from its nearest selected point. Random vertices samples mesh vertices uniformly, while Centroid FPS starts near the mesh-vertex centroid and PCA-extrema FPS starts at the extremes along the object’s principal axes. Saliency FPS favors sharp edges, corners, and open boundaries before spreading the points. Visibility–saliency also favors points visible from many viewing directions. Hull + saliency + repair starts with eight visible anchors around the object’s outer shape, adds points using saliency FPS, and replaces rarely visible points.
The main BOP experiments use this last strategy with 64 keypoints.
blocks.zh:
安置策略. 策略平衡对象形状的覆盖范围

blocks.en: 4.5 Underspecified CAD
Figure 8 : Underspecified CAD variants of HANDAL object 27 (spatula) [ 17 ] : original textured model (left), texture removed (middle), and 20% removed from one end along the principal axis (right).
blocks.zh: 图8: HANDAL 对象27(spatula)[17]的未指定CAD变体 [17]:原纹理模型(左),纹理去除(中),沿主轴(右)从一端去除20%.

blocks.en:
To test whether real observations can compensate for CAD deficiencies, we remove texture or part of the geometry from 19 HANDAL objects (Figure 8 ).
We reconstruct the objects from onboarding videos with NuRec [ 42 ] and replace half of the synthetic training images with NuRec composites.
Compared with matched composites of the degraded CAD model, NuRec improves validation AR by an estimated 23.6 and 16.3 points in the two settings, respectively. These gains are consistent across most objects; Appendix B details the training protocol, statistical analysis, and results.
blocks.zh:
为了检验真实的观测是否能够弥补CAD的缺陷,我们从19个HANDAL对象(图8 )中去除纹理或部分几何.
我们用 NuRec [42] 来重建登机录像中的物体, 用 NuRec 复合材料来替换一半的合成训练图像。
与退化的CAD模型相匹配的复合材料相比,NuRec将AR验证在两种环境下分别改进了约23.6分和16.3分. 这些收益在大多数目标上是一致的;附录B详细介绍了培训协议、统计分析和结果。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion

We present DOPER, which learns detection and keypoints jointly and uses geometric fitting to estimate object pose. The same keypoints support multi-view estimation and heatmap refinement, while synthetic initialization and partial real supervision enable adaptation. DOPER achieves strong RGB results across four object-pose benchmarks and supports illumination adaptation and temporal pose estimation on SPEED+ and SHIRT. Our HANDAL study further shows that reconstructions from onboarding videos can compensate for missing texture and incomplete CAD geometry.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍DOPER,它共同学习检测和关键点,并使用几何特征来估计物体的姿势。 同样的关键点支持多视图估计和热映射改进,而合成初始化和部分真实监督则有利于适应。 DOPER在四个对象可控基准上实现了强大的RGB结果,并支持照明适应和对SPEED+和SHIRT作出时间估计。 我们的HANDAL研究进一步表明,从登机录像中重建可以弥补缺失的纹理和不完整的CAD几何.

blocks.en:
These results leave several challenges open: reducing per-object training and refinement costs, and making reconstruction-based adaptation independent of annotated poses.
Furthermore, a universal metric keypoint detector could help streamline object onboarding and reduce reliance on object-specific training data generation.
blocks.zh:
这些结果留下了若干挑战:减少每个对象的培训和完善费用,使基于重建的适应独立于附加说明的构成。
此外,通用的度量键点探测器可有助于简化对象登机和减少对特定对象培训数据的依赖。

blocks.en: Appendix D HccePose training details

We adapt the released HccePose(BF) [ 69 ] ResNet34 training recipe.
We train one object-specific network for each of the 101 objects across HOPEv2, HANDAL, and HOT3D, using the same frozen per-object PBR image and instance populations as our DOPER baselines, without real target-dataset supervision.
Each encoder is initialized from ImageNet-pretrained ResNet34 weights.
Supervision comprises visible-object masks and hierarchical encodings of rendered front- and back-surface coordinates, preserving the original CAD coordinate frames, millimeter units, and camera calibration.
blocks.zh:
我们改编了发布的HccePose(BF)[69]ResNet34训练配方.
我们为跨越HOPEv2、HANDAL和HOT3D的101个物体中每个物体训练一个特定物体网络,使用与我们的DOPER基线相同的每个物体被冻结的PBR图像和实例群,而没有真正的目标数据集监督。
每个编码器都从ImageNet预装的ResNet34重量开始初始化.
监督包括可见物体口罩和制成的前表面和后表面坐标的分级编码,保留原来的CAD坐标框、毫米单位和照相机校准。

blocks.en:
Input crops are resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 , with 128 × 128 128\times 128 output maps and a bounding-box padding factor of 1.5 1.5 .
We retain the released dynamic zoom-in augmentation, comprising scale jitter in [ 0.75 , 1.25 ] [0.75,1.25] and center shifts of up to 25 % 25\% of the bounding-box dimensions, together with its GDR-Net-style photometric augmentation and ImageNet normalization in BGR channel order.
Training uses Adam with a constant learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , β = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) \beta=(0.9,0.999) , and zero weight decay, with batch size 24, automatic mixed precision (AMP), and dynamic loss scaling on a single NVIDIA L40 per model.
The released adaptive hierarchical losses are retained, with objective ℒ = 3 ​ ℒ front + 3 ​ ℒ back + ℒ mask \mathcal{L}=3\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{front}}+3\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{back}}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{mask}} .

DOPER detections and box jitter. We keep the 101 fixed 50,000-attempt HccePose endpoints and replace CNOS/FastSAM boxes with detections from the frozen DOPER model bank, retaining the original detection scores.
DOPER keypoints and P n n P do not filter these proposals.
Both variants scan every test image with every object model, using a confidence threshold of 0.15 and at most five detections per object and image.
The jitter variant revisits missing poses or poses with mean front-code reprojection error above 8 pixels.
It perturbs the box center by { − 0.10 , − 0.05 , 0 , 0.05 , 0.10 } \{-0.10,-0.05,0,0.05,0.10\} of its width and height and its scale by { 0.85 , 0.90 , 1 , 1.10 , 1.15 } \{0.85,0.90,1,1.10,1.15\} , removing duplicate crops.
Among valid candidates that reduce reprojection error, it selects the largest front-code inlier fraction, breaking ties by reprojection error and then grid order; otherwise, a valid original pose is retained.
Each original detection produces at most one pose per variant.

blocks.en:
We time one DOPER model for T-LESS object 1 on 24 test images from six scenes.
For multi-view inference, each image is combined with three other views of the same scene.
Images are decoded and resident on the GPU, model loading and the initial upload are excluded.
After a warm-up pass over all images, we time each image four times and report the mean latency.
We benchmark on an NVIDIA DGX Station with one GB300 GPU, using PyTorch 2.13 and CUDA 13.0 at PyTorch’s default precision (TF32 in convolutions).
